_note: Ground truth for the 20261014_161315 frame set, derived from the board run's own free-text descriptions (talk.jsonl). That is a real limitation: the labels come from the same model being scored, so they measure whether a closed list can carry what the model already perceives, NOT whether its perception is right. A human-labelled set would answer the second question; this one answers the first, which is what decides the contract.
